_comment: Site settings. beta_noindex: while true, every page carries a noindex tag so search engines do not list the unfinished archive (set to false at launch). watch_lead_in_seconds: each '▶ watch' link starts this many seconds BEFORE the passage (never before 0:00) so a listener hears the words in context; the printed time and the citation stay exact. suggest_url: the page on techspressionism.com that holds the 'Suggest a correction' Gravity Form (leave empty to hide the links). suggest_params: the form's dynamic-population parameter names for the recording (e.g. salon-081), the time in seconds, and the passage text.
